title: Validate relay addresses
responsibility: Normalize an allowed relay origin and derive its host WebSocket endpoint.

inputs.name: relayOrigin.value
inputs.description: A relay URL passed to relayOrigin; undefined is treated as an empty string and returns null. The parsed URL must use HTTPS or loopback HTTP (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]) and have no credentials, nonroot path, query, or fragment; there is no fallback address.

inputs.name: relaySocketUrl.origin
inputs.description: A relay URL passed through relayOrigin before endpoint construction; it must satisfy the same HTTPS or loopback HTTP and bare-origin restrictions.

inputs.name: relaySocketUrl.hostId
inputs.description: Host identifier inserted literally in the socket path; it must match /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/ and is the first 40 hexadecimal characters of the public-key SHA-256 identity.

outputs.name: relayOrigin
outputs.description: Returns the URL origin (scheme, host, and any nondefault port) for an accepted address, or null when parsing or validation fails.

outputs.name: relaySocketUrl
outputs.description: Returns a WebSocket endpoint with https changed to wss or http changed to ws and the host ID inserted in the connection path. Credentials are not included; invalid origins or host IDs throw Error("Invalid relay address.").

errors.name: Error
errors.description: relaySocketUrl throws this Error when relayOrigin(origin) returns null or the host ID fails the 40-character lowercase hexadecimal pattern; its message is Invalid relay address.
